hypothesis: Density-core segmentation before clearance clipping improves fixed real-object localization versus the previous connected-components result and published TRAVEL/HDBSCAN segmenters; uncertainty-aware temporal evidence improves sparse-target recall without increasing negative episodes.
note: Shared geometry/tracking isolate segmentation differences. TRAVEL here uses its original AOS implementation on shared non-ground context; a separate ground audit exercises original TGS+ AOS. This is not a comparison to a neural SOTA detector. Existing real annotations and IoU thresholds are unchanged; real precision remains unavailable.
